Dictation settings

Each phrase you say is matched against the words below before it is typed. A phrase that matches none is typed as you said it, so keep the spoken form short and in lower case.

The fingerprint names the model the phrases were checked against; a model swapped without it starts again from the defaults.

Spoken form, lower case
Expected 64 hex characters. That value is 6.
Sent with every correction you make.

Corrections are kept for this device only. Clearing them restores the defaults the model shipped with, and the fingerprint above is checked again on the next phrase.

A phrase you correct twice in one session is offered as a new entry the next time you open these settings, with the spoken form already filled in.

Nothing typed through dictation leaves this device unless a note to the agent is attached to it.
